verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs claim seamless integration with Hugging Face models and support for 200+ model architectures on the Hub. They also document running custom Hub models with --trust-remote-code for online serving or trust_remote_code=True for offline inference, so the core of the story is covered. missing for 10: an explicit description of the automatic download flow (e.g., serving a model by its Hub ID), plus independent or hands-on corroboration of pulling and running models from Hugging Face.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can download and run open models directly from Hugging Face

citations.quote: Seamless integration with popular Hugging Face models
vLLM seamlessly supports 200+ model architectures on HuggingFace
on the Hugging Face Model Hub, simply set `trust_remote_code=True` for offline-inference or `--trust-remote-code` for the online serving.
